title: Textile and apparel products, specific rules by tariff classification
applies_to: Controls the country of origin of imported textile and apparel products for purposes of the Customs laws generally, from any country, except as to Israel (19 CFR 102.21(a)).
licence: US Government work, public domain (17 U.S.C. 105)
